text:
tariq: Customer report (BioScale) - Feb invoice duplicated. One PDF missing embeddings and amounts off by $0.12. Ticket #BILL-11001.
billing-bot: reconcile-daily completed 2025-07-10T07:00:00Z. Alert: duplicate_invoice_group for customer_id=BS-22 period=2025-02.
jess: invoice ids?
tariq: INV-2025-45122 and INV-2025-45122-aux. Customer sees both. INV-2025-45122 (first) lacks embedding_line_items.
ops: can finance void dup and issue credit while eng investigates?
chloe: Approve manual remediation; cap refund $10k. Authorize void + credit and attach missing items to canonical invoice.
dev-oncall: quick log grab -> line_item flush hit a transient SQL timeout; retry path created a new invoice because idempotency key was null. Snippet: ```2025-02-28T23:59:59Z ERROR invoice_writer: write_line_items timeout
2025-02-28T23:59:59Z INFO invoice_writer: retry create (idempotency_key=null)
2025-02-28T23:59:59Z INFO invoice_writer: created INV-2025-45122-aux (no line_items)```
jess: running fix: `./tools/finance/void_credit.py --invoice INV-2025-45122-aux --reason "duplicate retry"`
jess: done. Credit CR-9981 for $4,210.12 issued; duplicate voided; customer notified. Updated ticket #BILL-11001.
dev-oncall: plan: hotfix to (1) derive fallback idempotency when request_id missing (sha256(customer_id+billed_period+usage_checksum)), (2) wrap invoice+line_items in DB transaction, (3) persist currency as integer cents. Will open PR and run a reconciliation sweep post-deploy.
ops: add runbook step: before void, search invoices for same customer+period created within 3 minutes and compare line_items/totals. Add alert rule for near-duplicate invoices.
tariq: thanks team. Ticket updated and postmortem requested (BILL-11001-PM). :thumbsup:
